products.name: Sony Mobile ES mono power amplifier
products.description: Mobile ES mono power amplifier: 600 W × 1 RMS at 4 ohms; 1,000 W × 1 RMS at 2 ohms. Resonance-damping compact aluminium case, combined pre-outs, updated connection terminal/control panel and included bass remote. Dimensions: 270 × 60 × 215 mm.
products.image_note: The source price list reuses one amplifier family image across all five channel variants; exact chassis differences are not shown.
